description: When to use this style (one sentence).
look: Image prompt prefix that defines the medium: what kind of footage or artwork this is, camera/film/texture, light, palette.
imageRules: Extra rules every keyframe must follow.
negative: What this style must never look like.
camera: Camera grammar for the cinematographer: lenses, distances, moves allowed.
motion: Sentence appended to every motion prompt.

characterSheet.prompt: A 2x2 grid of four images of the same {who} in {set}: top-left front view head and shoulders, top-right three-quarter view, bottom-left side profile, bottom-right full body. {look}. Identical face, body, wardrobe and details in all four. Thin white gutters between panels. No text, no labels.
